projection.host_paths: Named portable placeholders replace local roots; original commands otherwise retained.
projection.execution_identities: Session, process, extension-instance and job identifiers removed.
projection.private_endpoints: Internal service origins replaced by named placeholders; package identity and failure outcome retained.
projection.hash_semantics: Hashes inside evidence retain their original input/raw-artifact meaning. They are not hashes of these projected public files.
projection.reference_semantics: Embedded filenames refer to the original task layout. Public mappings and unshipped dependencies are recorded in coverage-summary.json.
notes: Historical test hash precedes the final explicit node:process import. Retain its recorded input binding; final green and focused lint receipts bind the final test bytes.

evidence.scope: Real settings module, HTML, DOM utility and restore module; simulated browser runtime/storage and injected file/module/storage failures. No live extension or browser access.
